title: Port scripts/susi-worktree.sh into susi workflow start
goal: Making an agent's own worktree is susi workflow start alone: the Rust start gains what only the script did (the start lock, the tool-named default name in the script's date form, the optional base, parking the primary, the sccache and watcher steps, the cloud-session wording and the script's exit codes); scripts/susi-worktree.sh is a stub that execs susi so docs and branches cut before the port keep working; the agent bootstrap tests pin the behaviour through the stub and the binary, with a Windows run with Git's usr/bin off PATH; docs/workflow-speed.md records the re-measured susi workflow check as a robustness change, not a timing one
